findings.label: git diff main --stat shows out-of-scope files (informational)
findings.detail: `git diff main --stat` includes playhq-worker/src/index.ts and larger page.tsx deltas because the branch merge-base (2dd013e) is behind main; those are committed Live-Scores history, not this feature. `git status` confirms the uncommitted working-tree changes are exactly the five in-scope files (page.tsx, accuracyChecks.ts, ManageMastersDialog.tsx, master-manage-logic.ts, master-manage-logic.test.ts). No action required; not a feature change.

findings.label: Rename collision guard is best-effort TOCTOU (accepted by design)
findings.detail: Concurrent renames toward the same name can still create a duplicate, surfaced on the next getSavedMasters() refresh. Documented in the renameMaster JSDoc; the design marks a DB unique constraint out of scope. Non-blocking, no change required.
